raw_segments.text: He ceased. Mr. Bloom glanced from his angry mustache to Mr. Powers' mild face and Martin
Cunningham's eyes and beard gravely shaking. Noisy, self-willed man. Full of his son. He
is right. Something to hand on, if little Ruddy had lived. See him grow up. Hear his
voice in the house, walking beside Molly in an eaten suit. My son, me and his eyes. Strange
feeling it would be, from me, just a chance.
